title: An e2e failure found only after its pages close keeps no screenshot
notes: The 'ffmpeg still running afterwards' check runs after the scenario has closed its pages; it keeps the viewer record and console but cannot take a screenshot. All failures observed while a page is open keep one. The owner chose fix/simplify/land after three blind reviews of the evidence code; this remaining diagnostic gap is recorded rather than expanding that work. (D-087) Dropped: test tooling that protects no viewer outcome. It returns if a queue failure goes undiagnosed for want of the screenshot.
